responsibility: This convenience header centralizes the large set of GCC backend and middle-end headers needed by the gm2 frontend tree-building code. Its role is purely infrastructural: it creates a single include point for core tree, gimple, diagnostics, CFG, cgraph, target, folding, storage-layout, and related APIs so the neighboring m2*.cc files can manipulate GCC IR and compiler services without each repeating the same backend include inventory.
